title: Distributed Attraction-Repulsion Potential for Multi-Agent Formation Control
summary: In this paper, a distributed multi-agent formation control driven by the gradient of the Lennard-Jones potential is analyzed. For collision-free initial data, we prove global well-posedness together with a uniform lower bound on all inter-agent distances, thereby excluding hard collisions. Taking the total energy as a Lyapunov function, LaSalle's invariance principle shows that every positive limit point is an equilibrium.
